review.why: Sets up, audits and fixes conversion tracking to ad and analytics platforms, firing on confirmed success and proving a test conversion arrived.
review.summary: Separates lead-generation from ecommerce conversions, then runs a setup or audit flow from three facts: what counts, where it lands, what runs it. Includes success-signal snippets for form and booking tools, importable tag manager recipes, a symptom table, verdict rules for mismatched numbers and a rule to diagnose before changing anything.
strengths: Every finding says how it is known: observed, reported or inferred
Diagnosis comes before any change, and live accounts need a named target
Compares browser-side and server-side options on the real trade-offs
cautions: Large: needs a tag manager workspace and platform access to finish
Dated platform deadlines it cites will age
Marks one commercial tool as a partner and discloses it
